bet.title: PLACE YOUR BET
text: Click chips to build your bet, and click the pile to take one back.
The minimum bet is {minBet}. Press DEAL when you are ready.

drop.title: CARDS DROP BEADS
text: Every card drops one bead for each symbol on it: an ace drops 1, a jack, queen or king drops 10.
The beads bounce through the pins and stack up in your board.

curve.title: STAY UNDER THE CURVE
text: Beads under the curve are green. The bead the curve crosses is yellow.
A bead above the curve is red, and one red bead busts your board: you lose your bet.

turn.title: YOUR MOVE
text: STAND ends your turn: the dealer turns over its hidden card and draws while it has fewer than {standsAt} beads.
DOUBLE doubles your bet for exactly one more card.

win.title: HOW TO WIN
text: Finish with more beads than the dealer, or watch the dealer drop a red one.
{yellows} yellow beads without a red one are a BLACKJACK and pay 3 to 2.
You play {hands} hands with {chips} chips: leave with as many as you can.

quant.title: Quant researcher in Zug
quant.epilogue: {name} took {department} to a hedge fund in Zug and now predicts markets with the same calm once reserved for Gauss Jack's probability curves. The models are stochastic, the bonus is not, and the blackboard has not been wiped since 2026.
quant.alt: A researcher filling a giant blackboard with formulas
quant.caption: Gauss Jack number skills found a new home on a very large blackboard.
quant.salary: CHF 400k + a bonus nobody can explain
quant.housing: A sunny flat in Zug, with room for a blackboard

phd.title: PhD student at ETH, year 7
phd.epilogue: {name} stayed in {department} for a PhD. It is year seven, the supervisor wants "one more paper", the coffee machine knows {name} by name, and the thesis is "basically done". The doctoral hat is already being glued together from pizza boxes.
phd.alt: A grinning graduate wearing a doctoral hat built from pizza boxes
phd.caption: Your doctoral hat is 80 % pizza box. Your thesis is 80 % done. Since 2029.
phd.housing: A WG room with space for one more book

masters.title: Master's student at ETH (again)
masters.epilogue: {name} finished the bachelor in {department} and walked straight back up the steps of the main building for a Master's. Same lecture halls, same Mensa queue, new excuse: "the job market will be better in two years".
masters.alt: Two students walking down the steps of the ETH main building
masters.caption: You left the main building for 4 minutes, then enrolled for a Master's.

mcdonalds.title: Fast-food crew at Zürich HB
mcdonalds.epilogue: {name} graduated in {department} and now runs the fastest fryer at a burger place in Zürich HB. The throughput is legendary, and the diploma hangs proudly next to the order screen.
mcdonalds.alt: A cat in a fast-food uniform and headset serving a burger
mcdonalds.caption: Your new manager is a cat. It is still more organised than your study group.
mcdonalds.salary: CHF 24/h + all the fries you can carry
mcdonalds.housing: A short commute from Zürich HB
